modelOverview: Launched in 1996, the Tank Française reinterpreted Cartier's original 1919 Tank with an integrated bracelet and rounded case links, becoming one of the maison's most recognisable modern dress watches. The Medium (midsize) model sits between the Large and Small versions and is a popular unisex/ladies' size, most commonly seen in a steel-and-gold two-tone execution.

W51012Q4.materials: Stainless steel case and bracelet with 18k yellow gold links and octagonal crown set with a blue spinel cabochon
W51012Q4.dial: Silver-grained dial with black Roman numerals and blued sword-shaped hands; date window at 3 o'clock
W51012Q4.description: The Tank Française Medium in steel and 18k yellow gold pairs Cartier's rounded, integrated-bracelet Tank case with the brand's signature blue cabochon crown. It is a durable, everyday two-tone dress watch, offered here fully sourced and authenticated.

variants.Steel & Gold: Two-tone steel and 18k yellow gold Tank Française Medium with a silver-grained Roman numeral dial, date window, and matching two-tone bracelet with concealed clasp.

W4TA0028.materials: Stainless steel case set with 26 brilliant-cut diamonds (1.09ct) and integrated steel bracelet; sapphire crystal
W4TA0028.bezel: Steel bezel set with brilliant-cut diamonds
W4TA0028.dial: Silvered sunray dial with Roman numerals and blued-steel sword-shaped hands; faceted steel crown set with a synthetic blue cabochon spinel
W4TA0028.description: Note: reference W4TA0028 is the Medium Tank Française in steel with a diamond-set case, rather than a white gold Tank Louis Cartier. It belongs to the 2023 relaunch of the integrated-bracelet Tank, pairing 26 brilliant-cut diamonds with a silvered sunray dial and blued sword hands on a quartz movement. Every piece is fully sourced and authenticated before sale.

variants.Steel – Diamond Bezel: Medium Tank Française in stainless steel with a case set with 26 brilliant-cut diamonds (1.09ct), silvered sunray dial and blued-steel sword hands, on the integrated steel bracelet.

WSTA0105.materials: Stainless steel case and integrated steel bracelet; sapphire crystal
WSTA0105.dial: Silvered dial with Roman numerals and blued-steel sword-shaped hands; faceted steel crown set with a synthetic cabochon-shaped spinel
WSTA0105.description: Note: Cartier lists reference WSTA0105 as the Medium Tank Française in steel with a silvered dial, rather than a blue-dial Tank Must. It is the standard quartz configuration of the 2023-generation Tank Française, with the redesigned integrated bracelet and faceted spinel-set crown. Every piece is fully sourced and authenticated before sale.

variants.Steel – Silver Dial: Medium Tank Française in stainless steel with a silvered Roman-numeral dial and blued-steel sword hands (documented by Cartier as silvered rather than blue), on the integrated steel bracelet.
